title: fix(server): Handle premature stream ending
body:
Closes #7603

## 🎯 Changes

- This fixes an unexpected TypeError in tRPC, which is also kind of a typesafety blind spot because of the aforementioned `as` casting in the code. Specifically, if an async iterable ends early, before producing the 'return' chunk', in the jsonl parser, the code didn't notice because it didn't check `done`, and it would try to destructure the result, which could cause the TypeError. ## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Improved JSONL stream handling when a stream ends before all expected data is received.
  - Incomplete streams now report a clear “Stream closed unexpectedly” error instead of an unclear iteration error.
  - Improved error consistency for incomplete data consumed through asynchronous iterables and promises.
  - Added coverage for truncated streams consumed through asynchronous iterables and promises.
  - Prevented unexpected type errors when streams close cleanly before all chunks arrive.
